Proposes the TRG reporting standard for real-time voice agents, arguing evaluation must shift from component latency to state-verified grounded outcomes including post-disruption recovery and multiparty turn-taking.

Interprets safety alignment of diffusion LLMs as an energy barrier in the denoising landscape and derives three training-free detection signals (step-0 logit ratio and two kinetic-energy trajectory velocities) from the model's internal dynamics.

An agentic protocol-to-task compiler that turns natural-language laboratory protocols into 300 certified, executable embodied tasks with step-level success specifications — automated benchmark construction for scientific discovery agents.
